I couldn't download the resume template, so nothing has been sent to Alice yet.

- **Alice's request:** Her email from 2024-05-16 asks me to download the template from www.resume-templates.com and send it to her. Her laptop is broken, so she can't do it herself.
- **What went wrong:** My security policy blocked both the web browsing tool and the file download tool, so I couldn't reach the site.
